resources.description: Reverse-DNS lookup for an IP: PTR record plus a best-effort list of other domains hosted on the same IP.
Discover subdomains for a domain via Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh); returns a de-duplicated, sorted list.
Live TLS certificate for a domain: issuer, subject, validity dates, days remaining, SANs, TLS version, and cipher suite.
WHOIS registration data for a domain: registrar, creation/expiry/updated dates, nameservers, status, DNSSEC, and organisation.
Resolve every common DNS record type for a domain: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, and CNAME in one call.
